description: Steel TV wall bracket. Four fully fixed circular 12 mm outside-diameter washer footprints at x=0, (y,z)=(30,10),(30,30),(170,10),(170,30). External TV mounting plate represented by total force (50,-400,0) N distributed over x=300, y=50..150, z=0..40. No explicit screw bores or passive mounting plate. Minimum member size 5 mm; 2 mm elements; design volume fraction 0.15.
